title: 皐月賞の後に・一冠めっ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio absolutely smashes the Satsuki Sho. She points a finger to the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is the same pose Symboli Rudolf did when she won. I can feel her strong desire to obtain all three crowns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race is the Japanese Derby, a prestigious trial that all racers dream of conquering.
